# PH VISION LTD — কোম্পানি ম্যানেজমেন্ট সিস্টেম
PH VISION LTD is a leading agro-chemical company operating in Bangladesh. This enterprise web application manages:
- Dealers, Credit limits, Dues & Ledgers
- Field Officers, Territories, Areas & Employee Records
- Products, Batches, Expiry Tracking & Categories
- Multi-Godown Inventory & Stock Transfers
- Raw Materials, Suppliers & Production Tracking
- Sales Invoices with A4 Printing
- Accounts & Expenses Tracking
- Area-wise Collection & Low Stock Alerts
Language: Bengali (বাংলা)
Developer Credit: রেদওয়ান করিম রাহিব
